integrity: A complete exact finite-state certificate is provided. Two independent arithmetic predicates were compared on every reduced state. The mathematical claim has not received independent audit; originality retains normal literature-search uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies coverings by prime divisors of 111111 only. Failure of this cover does not imply primality, and no general all-length covering or prime-existence conjecture is resolved. The precise residue counts are finite CRT quantities after a proved periodic reduction.
title: Exact six-period repunit-cover spectrum for symmetric decimal padding
